./surface-download-prompt.purpose: The shell mounts the single host download decision surface.

./surface-download-toaster.purpose: The shell mounts notifications for surface-owned downloads.

./surface-event-bridge.purpose: The shell connects native surface events once per application lifetime.

./surface-host.purpose: Workspace review reserves a host slot for the active native surface.

./surface-launcher.purpose: Workspace launch UI opens available plugin surfaces through their owner.

./surface-occlusion.purpose: The shell coordinates native surface visibility when shell dialogs occlude it.

./translations.purpose: The single i18n composition loads this feature's pure resource bundle.
